actions.name: charge
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.G9PENY6nw0xRxCJW.Item.ORrGdhTLKLTKK3BH]{Horn} attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra [[/damage average]] damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be knocked &reference[prone].

actions.name: innate spellcasting
actions.desc: The unicorn's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 14). The unicorn can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components: At will: [[/item .Mzh95utKDPIrjiH8]]{detect evil and good}, [[/item .SbSvZKkJASyk8jKo]]{druidcraft}, [[/item .pRMvmknwLf2tdMTj]]{pass without trace} 1/day each: [[/item .3MYDjS6k9IYL0aTj]]{calm emotions}, [[/item .TkJ8Wtg1L7TZtspm]]{dispel evil and good}, [[/item .gMrWeG8fMDPRFiVe]]{entangle}

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two attacks: one with its [[/item .f7m44y4TqYYcunMj]]{hooves} and one with its [[/item .ORrGdhTLKLTKK3BH]]{horn}.

actions.name: teleport
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically teleports itself and up to [[lookup @labels.description.affects activity=8owft3XymVhz240J]] it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the unicorn is familiar with, up to [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=8owft3XymVhz240J]] away.

actions.name: hooves
actions.desc: The unicorn makes one attack with its [[/item .f7m44y4TqYYcunMj]]{hooves}.

actions.name: shimmering shield
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=dnd5eactivity000]] of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: magic weapons
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: healing touch
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} touches another creature. The target magically regains [[/heal average]]. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.
